GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 11 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 12 Lengths Two Wide turning, one-paced in Straight # last throughout
Jumped okay & Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 7.5 Lengths turning, Lost Ground in Straight # never a threat
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn then Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses

No rush from the gate balanced up better than Mid Field though & against the fence 5 Lengths (1400m), three back going ok 600, room to come Through Inside cornering & Quickly making Ground , charging late looked the one before winner descended from the clouds late # looked winner
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for a run from the 500m until passing the 400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only ok went Straight across to fence settled back fourth last 7 Lengths (1200m), awkwardly placed To The Turn , off fence Straight no room though, Clear late held # inconclusive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages and near the 1400m was awkwardly placed near heels, shifted out and bumped. Disappointed for a run and steadied near the 300m, had some difficulty obtaining clear running until near the 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, hooked straight across & Settled Down 7 Lengths on fence, Moved Up to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, veered Wide around riderless horse on turn, ran on in Straight and only just missed. [Stewards: raced keenly early/middle stages.] # unlucky not to win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Inconvenienced near the 300m. Laid in on the entrance to the home straight

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok settled down three back fence 4 Lengths (1200m), going ok 450 needing a gap, gap came into the Straight & winding up steadily Soon After , took over last 50m came away # too solid late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Momentarily held up near the 400m. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled Mid Field Two Wide 5 Lengths 800m, started to work into the race Middle Of Track from the 400m but still gave Leader a big break Straightening Up , gradually knuckled down last 200m and as Leader came back to her she was bit too strong # finished too well

Jumped ok Not Bustled settled down Two Wide last 9-10 Lengths (1400m), wider before Turn , Straightened Up widest runner 6 Lengths away, made a little headway (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME, Winkers FIRST TIME) # stuck to task
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. When questioned, Rdr stated mare did not begin as expected and when it was apparent mount would be obliged to race wide without cover, elected to steady and come back behind the field-added with the blinkers off, mare was not as keen early as has been.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped just ok went back settled in the final few fence 8 Lengths (1000m), off rail Turn , Straightened Up angling Through a gap, under urgings battled away Without threat # stuck to task
